$jsonSchema.title: Tool
$jsonSchema.description: One accounting utility: a Dashboard card (shared/layout.py APPS).

_id.description: The page's URL segment, e.g. fifo-inventory.

summary.description: The one sentence shown on the Dashboard card.

badge.description: Maturity label such as Prototype; null when there is none.

minimumPlanId.description: The lowest plan that includes the tool (a plans _id).

inputs.description: What the tool takes in. Shown when the card is hovered.

outputs.description: What the tool produces. Shown when the card is hovered.
